title: cloud: move every hosted HotCRM to v6.0.0 or later before the framework pin crosses the release carrying #26064, or its five same-named positions lose their permission sets
body:
Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 on the maintainer's word for cloud-lane items found during development, verbatim: 「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡」 and 「开发中涉及 cloud 车道的，也应该转给 cloud」. Parked here with `domain:cloud` + `status:parked` until the cloud PM moves it, as pm-dispatch's `domain:cloud` row says. ⛔ Not a claim; this repository does not dispatch it.

**Origin:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#24757, PR #26064 (Tier H, awaiting the maintainer's merge). It retires the position-name fold: a position no longer receives the permission set that merely shares its name. A position gets a set only through its declared `permissionSets`.

**Why cloud must act:** HotCRM declares `permissionSets` on its positions from v6.0.0 (hotcrm#2229, which closed hotcrm#2200). Releases before that (v5.x) declare none, so they rely on the fold. The earlier hold on #24757 (comment 6318977882) measured the cloud running a released HotCRM 5.x on its own framework pin. If the cloud's framework pin crosses the release that carries PR #26064 while it still runs HotCRM 5.x, the five same-named positions lose their sets. That failure is loud: each one logs a `granted: false` warning that says to declare `permissionSets`.

**Done when:** every hosted environment that runs HotCRM is on HotCRM v6.0.0 or later before the cloud's `@objectstack/*` pin moves to the release carrying PR #26064. Read it on the cloud's lockfile, then on one hosted environment: the five HotCRM positions still hold their sets after the pin move, and no `granted: false` fold warning is logged.

Blocked-by: none. The HotCRM move can happen now; it has to happen before the framework pin moves.
